Whole standing mausoleum: pale tan battered/plastered brick cube with shallow corner/face pilasters and recessed pointed blind niches; one tall south-facing pointed grille/window, small low side doorway, flat ledged roof/parapet around high cylindrical drum, bulbous tall densely fluted dome with repeated narrow ribs and surviving desaturated turquoise geometric tile band near lower dome/drum transition. Main drum has shallow vertical panels and small dark square aperture. Upper2001 dome is largely exposed tan; UNESCO documents later tile conservation/reproduction, so exact current retiling/door-window census and hidden opposite faces are bounded original estimates. Neighboring small mausoleum, freestanding minarets/ruins/graves/garden/people excluded; no copied inscriptions/pictorial sacred art.
